capabilities: Redact selected text via command palette, context menu, or ribbon icon
Choose among per-character, preserve-spaces, and fixed-length redaction styles
Pick a preset redaction character or supply any custom single character
Restrict or exclude redaction by folder with automatic path tracking
Redact multiple selections at once in a single undoable step
extras: Not yet in the community directory, so manual installation is required; needs Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The README warns that redaction is not secure: undo history, File Recovery snapshots, sync, and backups can retain the original text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to black out or censor selected text in a note for sharing or publishing.
summary: Selection redaction plugin that permanently replaces selected text with block characters or any chosen character in three styles.
